briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 and DeepSeek R2 escalate multi-agent AGI race amid compute crunch

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs push next-gen models with enhanced reasoning while regulatory scrutiny intensifies. Funding remains robust despite market volatility, with safety concerns mounting over agentic systems.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI released o4 with 40% gains in multi-step planning; Anthropic's Claude 4 Opus benchmarks lead in safety evals; DeepSeek R2 matches GPT-5 performance at 60% lower cost.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems and that DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level. NIST issues new agentic AI guidelines.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA ships Blackwell Ultra chips; Microsoft and Google announce 50% expansion of AI data centers in Texas and Arizona.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will the first AGI-level system emerge from a US or Chinese lab by 2028?
